name: Governance Branch Review
description: Governance-aware adaptive review of the current branch versus a base ref: maps changes, fans out ACGS-Lite-specific dimension reviewers, adversarially verifies findings, and emits a constitutional-invariant scorecard.

metadata.trigger: Reviewing ACGS-Lite branch changes before a PR

name: Verify Governance Fixes
description: Adversarially verifies that applied governance fixes actually close their findings by writing and executing concrete bypass attempts against the installed code.

name: Security Review
description: Reviews code for exploitable vulnerabilities, input validation gaps, auth/authz issues, hardcoded secrets, and OWASP concerns.

name: Code Review
description: Structured code review using tiered persona agents, confidence-gated findings, and a merge/dedup pipeline for changes before a PR.

name: Technical Planning
description: Creates structured implementation plans for multi-step software features: decisions, files, dependencies, and enumerated test scenarios.

name: Debug
description: Systematically finds root causes and fixes bugs: reproduces failures, traces errors, and investigates test failures or issue-tracker reports.
